elegant-wedding-banquet.title: Elegant Wedding Banquet
elegant-wedding-banquet.text: Thoughtfully prepared menus for ceremonies, receptions, and unforgettable celebrations. Includes Ethiopian and western fusion dishes. Service: Full setup, serving, and cleanup included.

reception-dining.title: Reception Dining
reception-dining.text: Served with style for intimate receptions and grand wedding nights. Authentic Doro Wot and habesha favorites alongside international options. Service: Full catering with elegant presentation.

ceremony-feast.title: Ceremony Feast
ceremony-feast.text: A warm menu selection designed for memorable wedding moments. Fusion of Ethiopian and international cuisine tailored to your guests. Service: Custom menu planning available.

executive-catering.title: Executive Catering
executive-catering.text: Polished meal service for meetings, team lunches, and company events. Meals delivered branded and on time. Service: Delivery only or full setup available.

business-lunch-package.title: Business Lunch Package
business-lunch-package.text: Reliable catering for productive sessions and client-facing occasions. Hot meals delivered in under 30 minutes. Service: Delivery included, setup optional.

corporate-gala.title: Corporate Gala
corporate-gala.text: Refined catering for launches, awards nights, and special business events. Full-service with elegant plating and professional staff. Service: Full catering with cleanup.

seasonal-corporate-dining.title: Seasonal Corporate Dining
seasonal-corporate-dining.text: Balanced, varied menus for recurring team meals and seasonal office gatherings. Ethiopian and international options. Service: Scheduled delivery plans available.

birthday-celebration-package.title: Birthday Celebration Package
birthday-celebration-package.text: Fresh dishes and sweet treats made for joyful gatherings. Includes custom cake options. Service: Full catering with setup and cleanup.

kids-party-catering.title: Kids' Party Catering
kids-party-catering.text: Fun, flavorful food that keeps every guest happy. Kid-friendly menus with colorful presentation. Service: Delivery or full setup available.

sweet-tables-and-desserts.title: Sweet Tables & Desserts
sweet-tables-and-desserts.text: Crowd-pleasing bites and dessert options for birthday celebrations. Cakes, cookies, and custom treats. Service: Delivery or event setup.

celebration-desserts.title: Celebration Desserts
celebration-desserts.text: Colorful cakes and treats to finish the party on a high note. Includes anniversaries, graduations, baby showers, and bridal showers. Service: Custom orders welcome.

fasting-meal-package.title: Fasting Meal Package
fasting-meal-package.text: Wholesome plant-based dishes prepared for seasonal fasting. Rich in flavor with traditional Ethiopian ingredients. Service: Delivery or full catering setup.

seasonal-holiday-catering.title: Seasonal Holiday Catering
seasonal-holiday-catering.text: Balanced fasting-friendly and festive meals for Christmas, Genna, New Year's, Epiphany, and more. Service: Full catering with traditional dining setup available.

rooftop-cocktail-package.title: Rooftop Cocktail Package
rooftop-cocktail-package.text: Elegant finger foods, canapés, and beverages for cocktail parties and product launches. Professional staff and refined presentation. Service: Full catering with staff included.

fusion-cocktail-menu.title: Fusion Cocktail Menu
fusion-cocktail-menu.text: A curated mix of Ethiopian bites and international appetizers for upscale social events. Custom menu planning available. Service: Setup, serving, and cleanup included.
